messages:
samir: Heads-up — planning to lift the API v2 opt-in flag into a gradual lift during the change window tomorrow at 22:00 UTC. Need client ops notes, clear pinning guidance, and a rollback play. @olivia can you own release notes?

olivia: Yep — I’ll draft the notes. Quick question: are we changing default behaviour server-side (default to v2) or only routing clients that opt in? Need exact language.

samir: Default will switch to v2 for unversioned requests. Clients can opt to pin to v1 via header `X-Api-Version: v1` or query param `?api_version=v1` — we should document both.

jules: Recommend adding an explicit server-side compatibility shim for a 30d grace period: keep v1 handlers active, log deprecated usage, and emit a warning header `X-Api-Deprecation: v1; will-deprecate=2025-05-20`. That buys clients time.

eng-oncall: For rollout monitoring: we should watch 1) 5xx rate on /generate and /chat 2) error-rate delta for clients older than last-6m SDK 3) latency p95 for v2 vs v1. If any breach (5xx > 0.5% or error-rate delta > 0.4%), abort.

pm-kate: Change window approved for Thu 22:00 UTC — will notify partner customers and post an incident-channel heads-up. I'll add a scheduled post to the status page with migration steps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary: api-proxy v2-shim -> us-west-1 group (5%) by samir at 1765432155

olivia: Draft release notes snippet: 
- Default API now routes to v2.
- To opt out: `curl -H "X-Api-Version: v1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` or add `?api_version=v1`.
- SDKs older than 0.9.0 should be updated — link to migration guide.

jules: Add this server-side curl to the notes for ops: 
```
# quick rollback to keep traffic on v1
redwoodctl rollout set --route api --target-version v1 --reason "emergency rollback" --force
```

eng-oncall: Can we get a small smoke test run immediately after canary with known prompt set? I can run a synthetic suite and post results.

samir: Yes run smoke against /health and three canonical prompts. If any mismatch in output shape or >10% failure on smoke, trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary succeeded: 10/10 health checks green, 0.02% 5xx during canary, promoting to 25% at 1765432190

olivia: I'll publish release notes 1 hour before the window and include the exact pin header and examples for JS/Python SDKs. Also adding a snippet for server teams to set `X-Api-Deprecation` header and where to find telemetry dashboards.

samir: Rollback plan: if alert thresholds hit, call the on-call phone, ping #incidents, and run the `redwoodctl` rollback snippet. Samir and eng-oncall will coordinate. Postmortem owner: @pm-kate.

pm-kate: I'll own comms and postmortem. Adding notes to the runbook now. :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted to 25% at 1765432190; promoted to 50% at 1765432220

eng-oncall: Running synthetic checks now — posting scores in 2m.

samir: Final threshold: abort and rollback if client error-rate increases >0.5% absolute or if major partners report breakage. Otherwise continue slow ramp to 100% over next 4 hours.

olivia: Got it. I'll include the partner contact list in the notes and the SDK patch links.

eng-oncall: Synthetic results: p95 latency +8ms, 5xx delta +0.03% — within thresholds. No major partner reports so far.

samir: OK — proceed. Remember to keep the deprecation grace period prominently in the notes and set dashboards to show v1 traffic by client SDK version.

pm-kate: Publishing status update and sending partner emails now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete to 50% at 1765432230 (scheduled next step manual).
